Application Data.NAME: Green Cleaners, LLC
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Green Cleaners, LLC is a full-service dry cleaning and laundry provider that specializes in eco-friendly cleaning solutions. Our operations include customer drop-off and pickup services, as well as in-house pressing and minor alterations. We maintain a commitment to safety and environmental responsibility, utilizing modern equipment and certified technicians for regular maintenance. Our team is trained in safe chemical handling practices, and we have established protocols for spill containment and emergency procedures. We also implement rigorous quality control measures to ensure customer satisfaction while minimizing risks associated with holding customer property.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: In the past three years, Green Cleaners, LLC has experienced two minor losses related to equipment malfunction. The first incident occurred on 03/15/2021, when a pressing machine malfunctioned, resulting in a loss of $2,000. This was promptly repaired with no ongoing issues. The second incident happened on 07/22/2022, involving a small chemical spill during a routine cleaning operation, which incurred a cleanup cost of $3,000. Both incidents have been resolved and no claims are currently outstanding.
Application Data.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 7:00 PM; Saturday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM; Closed Sunday
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Sentry Safe Model SFW123GTC, Class B, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security alarm system monitoring and routine patrol by licensed security personnel during non-operating hours.
